BiblicalUsage: Moses tells Israel to mark out their northern border, from the great sea to Mount Hor, and from Mount Hor to the entrance of Hamath. The word is to point out, to trace a boundary line. It appears only here, twice, in the business of drawing the map God gave them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the boundary lines matter because God drew them: the land was His gift, and its edges were His choosing, not theirs.
